prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE production city-map building sprite for tianshu, early-to-middle Qing Jiangnan region, 17th–18th century. The supplied Song Jiangnan image is a REFERENCE for the realistic material detail density and camera, NOT an edit target: generate an entirely new building of the stated type. Orthographic camera yaw45 elevation30; 2:1 dimetric ground projection, BOTH ground axes slopes precisely +0.5 and -0.5, verticals upright, parallel edges, NO perspective. Original South-facing entrance faces screen LOWER LEFT. True transparent RGBA background, all subject and short contact shadow completely inside canvas with at least 10% transparent margins. Very thin flat rectangular ground footprint with all three front ground corners clear; no thick diorama plinth. Realistic ancient architecture sprite, softly weathered off-white lime plaster, charcoal gray small fired clay roof tiles, gray brick/stone bases, dark timber and fine wood lattice windows. Modest Qing-style brick gate surrounds and restrained small carved trim; no ubiquitous imperial gilding, no giant ornamental roof curls. Light screen UPPER LEFT, small soft contact shadow screen LOWER RIGHT. NO sky, horizon, landscape, road outside footprint, humans, animals, calligraphy, labels, pseudo-writing, numbers, signage, watermark, checkers, plastic, cartoon, modern objects. This is an original generic game composite inspired by regional surviving Ming/Qing architectural forms, NOT a restoration of a named monument. ONE Qing Jiangnan county government courtyard; rear gray-tile audience hall, two low side offices, white enclosing walls and one plain south gate. Muted teal trim below rear eave, no garden, no yellow tiles. FOOTPRINT17x13 metres. Critical geometry revision, draw the thin rectangle ground pad FIRST: ground LEFT=(200,550), FRONT=(744,822), RIGHT=(1160,614), hidden BACK=(616,342). Every ground edge slope is EXACTLY +0.500 or -0.500. These are proportional coordinates: uniformly scale and translate entire building if needed, never distort. The camera is45deg yaw,30deg down, not a35deg or40deg elevation. Keep the 3 front ground corners plainly visible. Build the roof/walls parallel to the ground pad axes. SOUTH gate on LEFT-to-FRONT edge facing screen LOWER LEFT. Clean straight pad edges with no irregular vegetation outside. DO NOT stretch or shorten either footprint edge.
